_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bamidbar 13, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses directly.
translations.2: Send forth men to scout the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the sons of Israel — one man from the tribe of their fathers you shall send with him, every noble among them.
translations.3: And Moses sent them forth from the wilderness of Paran, at the word of God; all of them men, heads of the sons of Israel.
translations.4: And these are their names: from the tribe of Reuben — Shammua son of Zaccur.
translations.5: And from the tribe of Simeon — Shaphat son of Hori.
translations.6: And from the tribe of Judah — Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translations.7: And from the tribe of Issachar — Igal son of Joseph.
translations.8: And from the tribe of Ephraim — Hoshea son of Nun.
translations.9: And from the tribe of Benjamin — Palti son of Raphu.
translations.10: And from the tribe of Zebulun — Gaddiel son of Sodi.
translations.11: And from the tribe of Joseph — which is the tribe of Manasseh — Gaddi son of Susi.
translations.12: And from the tribe of Dan — Ammiel son of Gemalli.
translations.13: And from the tribe of Asher — Sethur son of Michael.
translations.14: And from the tribe of Naphtali — Nahbi son of Vophsi.
translations.15: And from the tribe of Gad — Geuel son of Machi.
translations.16: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent forth to scout the land. And Moses called Hoshea son of Nun — Joshua.
translations.17: And he sent them forth to scout the land of Canaan, and said to them: 'Go up first to the south, then go up to the mountain.'
translations.18: 'And observe the land — what it is, and the people who dwell in it — whether it is strong or slack, whether it is few or many.'
translations.19: 'And what is the land in which it dwells — whether it is good or poor; and what are the towns in which it dwells — whether they are in open encampments or in fortresses.'
translations.20: 'And what is the land — whether it is fat or lean, and whether there are planted trees in it or not. And be courageous, and take of its fruit.' And behold, this season was the days of the first-ripening of the grapes.
translations.21: And they went up and scouted the land, from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, toward Hamath.
translations.22: And they went up first to the south, and came to Hebron; and there were Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai — the children of the giants. And Hebron had already been built before Zoan, the seat of Egypt, by seven years.
translations.23: And they came to the Valley of the Cluster, and cut from there a branch and one cluster of grapes, and carried it on a pole between two; and also some of the pomegranates and of the figs.
translations.24: Therefore that place was named the Valley of the Cluster, on account of the cluster which the sons of Israel cut from there.
translations.25: And they returned from scouting the land, after forty days.
translations.26: And they journeyed until they came to Moses and Aaron, and the rest of the congregation of the sons of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and they answered them with the report — them and the rest of the congregation — and showed them the fruit of the land.
translations.27: And they recounted to him, and said: 'We went to the land to which you sent us, and indeed it flows with milk and honey — and here is its fruit.'
translations.28: 'However, the people who dwell in it are mighty, and the towns are very greatly fortified; and moreover, the children of the giants — we saw them there.'
translations.29: 'The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south; and the Hittites and the Jebusites and the Amorites dwell in the mountain; and the Canaanites dwell by the sea and along the bank of the Jordan.'
translations.30: And Caleb silenced the people toward what Moses had said, and said: 'Nay, we shall go up and seize it — for we are able to overcome them!'
translations.31: But the men who had gone with him said: 'We are not able to go up to the people, for they are stronger than us.'
translations.32: And they spread an evil slander against the land which they had scouted, to the sons of Israel, saying: 'The land through which we passed to scout it is a land that destroys its inhabitants; and all the people whom we saw in it are of great stature.'
translations.33: 'And we saw there the brutes — children of the giants from among their brutes — and we were in our own eyes as locusts; and so were we in their eyes.'
